title: MixedCupTensorClosure
statement: In the stages and tensor coordinates of [def-sf-mixed-cup-coefficient-data], with the elementary tensor predicates of [def-sf-mixed-cup-tensor-elementary] and field operation data of [def-sf-mixed-cup-field-operations], define the closure tensor normalization as equality to the canonical inverse common-stage tensor comparison [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Represent it at the common input coefficient field using the recorded scalar unitors of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and its actual stage-transition identification. Insert the source rational tensor normalization, the fixed common-stage tensor object equation and the target tensor normalization. The compositum of two copies of the input finite field is that same field, so this prescription applies to every input pair. The equality is required for every proof that this representative field dominates that compositum, hence is independent of that proof. This predicate fixes a morphism, not only its isomorphism class. In Lean this is a heterogeneous equality of the underlying morphisms; the source and target object identifications are the prescribed rational/common-stage tensor normalization equalities, so their transports admit no further choice.
